meanings.context: part of a cut of meat

m.t: Y estoy tan enojado conmigo mismo por no comprender.
m.e: And I'm just so mad at myself for not figuring it out.

m.t: Y había una voz todo alrededor que yo no podía comprender.
m.e: And there was this voice all around I could not fathom.

m.t: Las razones que él ha dado son difíciles de comprender.
m.e: The reasons that he gave are difficult to comprehend.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #6825926 by mervert1; English translation #6825923 by Eccles17

m.t: No parece comprender lo serio que es esto.
m.e: You don't seem to realize how serious this is.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #7305758 by arh; English translation #4903094 by Hybrid

m.t: Hay más cosas que las que puede comprender la razón.
m.e: There are more things than what reason can understand.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1134213 by marcelostockle; English translation #1134215 by marcelostockle

m.t: Los hará a todos comprender por qué necesitamos un techo.
m.e: Well, it'll give everyone a visceral understanding of why we need a roof.

m.t: No acabo de comprender lo que quieres decir.
m.e: I do not quite understand what you mean.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1213592 by Berbel; English translation #2083253 by freddy1

m.t: No consigo comprender la actitud mental de un hombre así.
m.e: I can't understand the psychology of such a man.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1490565 by arnxy20; English translation #249834 by \N

m.t: Algo está pasando aquí que no acabo de comprender.
m.e: There's something happening here that I don't quite understand.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1070820 by qweruiop; English translation #954413 by CK

m.t: Era demasiado joven para comprender... las consecuencias de sus acciones.
m.e: He was far too young to understand the consequences of his actions.

m.t: Quiero que este día salga todo bien, ¿me comprendes?
m.e: I want this day to go well, understood?

m.t: Tú comprendes lo que significa tomar una vida.
m.e: You understand what it means to take a life.

m.t: Comprendes el hecho de que nunca más volveremos a ver a esa mujer.
m.e: You do understand we're never gonna see this woman again.

m.t: Deja que hable el dinero, no su puto cuchillo, ¿comprendes?
m.e: Let the money do the talking, not his fucking knife, you understand? Mm-ah.

m.t: Estoy seguro de que comprendes por qué no podemos hacer eso.
m.e: I'm sure you understand why we can't do that.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #2944206 by teskmon; English translation #2537965 by CK

m.t: ¡Cosas que tú no comprendes van a pasar!
m.e: Things you don't understand are going to happen.

m.t: Y comprendes la idea que tiene la gente de su cocina.
m.e: And you understand how people approach their cooking.

m.t: Y tú comprendes que nunca antes la habíamos visto.
m.e: And you understand we never saw her before.

m.t: Pero yo me voy a quedar aquí el resto de mi vida, ¿comprendes?
m.e: But I have to spend the rest of my life here, do you understand?

m.t: No comprendes por lo que estoy pasando.
m.e: You don't understand me at all! You have no idea what I'm going through!

m.t: Señor, perdóneme, pero habla de asuntos que no comprende completamente.
m.e: Lord, forgive me, but you speak of matters YOU do not fully understand.

m.t: El corazón tiene razones que la razón no comprende.
m.e: The heart has reasons that reason doesn't understand.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #9814071 by Shishir; English translation #10121512 by DJ_Saidez

m.t: Tienes que dejarme hablar con ella, porque no comprende lo que sucede.
m.e: You got to let me talk to her because she doesn't understand what's going on.

m.t: La gente no comprende lo que está sucediendo actualmente.
m.e: People don't understand what's going on nowadays.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #10609401 by saverius; English translation #11267147 by Luornu

m.t: Hay pocos trabajos y... he de alimentar a mi familia, ¿lo comprende?
m.e: Jobs are scarce and... I've to feed the family, you understand.

m.t: La gente comprende la amenaza el tipo de persona a quien se enfrenta.
m.e: People understand the threat... the kind of person you're up against.

m.t: Él comprende plenamente de que él fue la razón del accidente.
m.e: He fully realizes that he was the cause of the accident.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1365999 by marcelostockle; English translation #298333 by zipangu

m.t: Sólo observaba, señor, que la gente no comprende bien las elecciones.
m.e: Well, I was just observing, sir, that people don't quite understand elections.

m.t: No sé si no comprende o no quiere comprender.
m.e: I can't tell whether you don't understand or you don't want to understand.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #5432596 by Seael; English translation #10125487 by DJ_Saidez

m.t: Solo mi madre me comprende de verdad.
m.e: Only my mother really understands me.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1783092 by marcelostockle; English translation #320572 by CK

m.t: Está claro que robó dinero de la caja fuerte.
m.e: It's clear that he stole money from the safe.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1585405 by Shishir; English translation #283553 by CM

m.t: Ella le robó mucho dinero, así que ahora está en la cárcel.
m.e: She stole a lot of money from him, so now she is in prison.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1330656 by Shishir; English translation #887409 by CK

m.t: El muchacho robó dinero de la bolsa de su madre.
m.e: The boy stole money from his mother's handbag.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #764777 by darinmex; English translation #268042 by CK

m.t: No solo robó la identidad de un famoso autor, quería ser dicho autor.
m.e: Not only did he steal a famous author's identity, he wanted to be said author.

m.t: Ella le robó un montón de dinero a él.
m.e: She stole a lot of money from him.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1077229 by hayastan; English translation #887410 by CK

m.t: ¿Tiene idea de a quién le robó anoche?
m.e: Have you any idea who he robbed last night?

m.t: Éste es el hombre que dicen que robó el coche.
m.e: This is the man who they say stole the car.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1055668 by Shishir; English translation #58325 by CM

m.t: La policía sospecha que él robó el banco.
m.e: The police suspect that he robbed the bank.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1172221 by erjabi; English translation #283557 by CK

m.t: Y los hijos de puta me robaron el reloj de mi abuelo.
m.e: And the bastards stole my grandfather's watch.

m.t: Me robaron mi tarjeta de crédito en el metro.
m.e: My credit card was stolen on the subway.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #8588451 by Kary; English translation #2846006 by englishchinese

m.t: Es que nos robaron tantas películas de acción.
m.e: It's just that they robbed us of so many action-packed movies.

m.t: ¿Qué sabes...? ¿de las herramientas que se robaron ayer?
m.e: What do you know about the finishing tools stolen yesterday?

m.t: Le robaron el su dinero de camino de vuelta a casa.
m.e: She was robbed of her money on her way home.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1752405 by marcelostockle; English translation #313127 by CK

m.t: A la pobre mujer mayor le robaron el dinero.
m.e: The poor old woman was robbed of her money.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1692204 by teskmon; English translation #63441 by CK

m.t: Al tipo le robaron el teléfono en un bar anoche.
m.e: Guy had his phone stolen at a bar last night.

m.t: Me atacaron y robaron de camino a casa.
m.e: I was attacked and robbed on my way home.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1686588 by Shishir; English translation #1669163 by Spamster

m.t: Él atrapó a un muchacho robando su reloj.
m.e: He caught a boy stealing his watch.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1031903 by jayefes65; English translation #299617 by CK

m.t: Me siento como si estuviera robando sus frases.
m.e: I feel like I'm stealing your sentences.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #3968237 by cueyayotl; English translation #3968240 by ddnktr

m.t: Él capturó a un chico robando su reloj.
m.e: He caught a boy stealing his watch.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1031902 by jayefes65; English translation #299617 by CK

m.t: Deambulan en grupo, robando cualquier cosa que puedan encontrar.
m.e: They roam in packs, stealing whatever they can find.

m.t: Hay más de ellos dentro, robando la tienda.
m.e: There's more of 'em inside, robbing the store.

m.t: Ahora me estás robando mi arma y mi mula.
m.e: Now you're thieving me gun and me mule.

m.t: No cuando estés robando un banco.
m.e: Not when you're robbing a bank.

m.t: Mira, no te he visto en 20 años, podrías estar por ahí, no sé... robando bancos.
m.e: Look, I haven't seen you in 20 years, you could be out there, I don't know... robbin' banks.

m.t: Creemos que te robaste las joyas del palacio.
m.e: We suspect that you've stolen the palace jewels.

m.t: ¿Qué hay con las pastillas que robaste de la escena del crimen?
m.e: What about the pills you stole from the crime scene?

m.t: Dices que salvaste mi vida, yo digo que robaste mis cosas.
m.e: You say you saved my life, I say you stole my shit.

m.t: Me robaste ¿Tú crees que soy idiota?
m.e: You stole from me. You think I'm an idiot?

m.t: ¿Luego de que me robaste todo?
m.e: After you stole everything from me?

m.t: Robaste un banco por mí.
m.e: You stole a bank for me.

m.t: - ¿Desde qué robaste el banco?
m.e: - Since you robbed the bank?

m.t: La mayor parte de lo que robé era basura... pero esto era interesante.
m.e: Most of what I stole was junk... but this was interesting.

m.t: Voy a devolver el teléfono que robé de inmediato.
m.e: I'll return the phone I stole right away.

m.t: Bueno, me veo bien con él, así que lo robé.
m.e: Okay, I look good in it, so I stole it.

m.t: Cuando robé ese banco, estaba enamorada de un hombre.
m.e: When I held up that bank, I was in love with a man.

m.t: Porque le robé 50 euros.
m.e: Because I stole 50 euros.

m.t: Así que lo trajiste aquí para robarle su velocidad.
m.e: So you brought him here to steal his speed.

m.t: ¿Se creyó que podía robarle a Alemania lo que le pertenece?
m.e: You thought you could take what belongs to Germany?

m.t: No lo sé, tenemos que robarle el coche o algo.
m.e: I don't know, we have to steal her car or something.

m.t: Le conoció la noche que iba a robarle.
m.e: She met him is the night she went to rob him.

m.t: Robarle a Cottonmouth fue lo que causó todo este lío.
m.e: Robbin' Cottonmouth was what caused all this trouble in the first place.

m.t: Manejar hasta Valle Eden y robarle al tipo, al rico.
m.e: Drove out to Eden Valley and robbed your guy, the rich one.

m.t: Creo que alguien me roba la luz cuando no me doy cuenta.
m.e: I think someone is stealing the light from me when I'm not aware.

m.t: ¿Qué debería hacer mi padre con una mujer que le roba?
m.e: What should my father do about a woman who steals from him?

m.t: No es la primera vez que ella le roba.
m.e: It's not the first time she stole from you.

m.t: Si debes matar, mata a un elefante, si debes robar, roba un tesoro.
m.e: If you must kill, kill an elephant and if you must rob, rob a treasury.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #3247976 by marcelostockle; English translation #2570325 by sabretou

m.t: Roba un banco y estarás robando la riqueza del norte.
m.e: Rob a bank and you're stealing northern wealth.

m.t: Que la muerte roba a la gente todas... las posibilidades imaginables.
m.e: She writes about death. That death robs people of all possibilities imaginable.

m.t: Cuando a ti te interesa, no tienes problemas en robarme dinero.
m.e: When it serves your interests, you have no problem stealing money from me.

m.t: Solo quieres que me quede para poder robarme mis antiguos deberes.
m.e: You just want me to stay here so you can steal all of my old homework.

m.t: Nada mejor que hacer que robarme y matar a mi ganado.
m.e: Nothing better to do than steal from me and kill my cattle.

m.t: Los enviaste a robarme y no les dijiste que era tu hijo.
m.e: You sent them to rob me and didn't tell them I was your son.

m.t: Creo que él estaba aquí para robarme.
m.e: I think he was here to rob me.

m.t: Sé que estás aquí para robarme.
m.e: I know you're here to rob me.

m.t: Trabajé 40 años para esa maldita empresa y se roban nuestra pensión.
m.e: Forty years I worked for that goddamn company, and now they're stealing our pension.

m.t: Especialmente las que se vuelven locas y roban cosas.
m.e: Especially the ones who go crazy and steal stuff.

m.t: No importa si roban los que tienen hambre.
m.e: It doesn't matter if those who are hungry, steal.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #10359520 by JSKabylie; English translation #10359524 by DJ_Saidez

m.t: Te roban en serio y no lo sabes.
m.e: You're getting robbed for real and you don't know.

m.t: Mira, a todo el mundo le roban tarde o temprano.
m.e: Look, everybody gets robbed sooner or later.

m.t: Si me llamas porque te roban, quizá te robe yo también.
m.e: You calling me 'cause you're getting robbed, I might rob your ass, too.

m.t: Estoy tan contenta de que esta antigua casa se haya vendido.
m.e: I'm just so happy this old house finally sold.

m.t: Cuando se entere mi mujer, no se pondrá contenta.
m.e: When my wife finds out, she won't be happy.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #2019588 by Joseshka; English translation #1877242 by Spamster

m.t: Hoy estoy muy contenta con mi embarazo.
m.e: Today I am very happy with my pregnancy.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1651391 by alexmarcelo; English translation #868785 by \N

m.t: Me alegro de que estés contenta.
m.e: I'm glad you're happy.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #12321260 by carlosalberto; English translation #2044488 by CK

m.t: ¿Estás contenta con tu trabajo nuevo?
m.e: Are you happy with your new job?
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #3120353 by marcelostockle; English translation #3123419 by chajadan

m.t: Ella no parece contenta de verme.
m.e: She doesn't look happy to see me.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1976333 by Shishir; English translation #1806247 by Spamster

m.t: Mi madre se pondrá muy contenta.
m.e: My mom will be pretty happy about that.

m.t: Estoy tan contenta por ti.
m.e: I'm so happy for you.

m.t: ¿Por qué estás siempre contenta?
m.e: Why are you always happy?
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #6813215 by arh; English translation #10151402 by DJ_Saidez

m.t: Estoy muy contenta que hayas encontrado otro tan rápido.
m.e: I was so pleased that you'd found someone else so fast.

m.t: Ella estaba contenta con su nuevo vestido.
m.e: She was pleased with her new dress.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1596407 by marcelostockle; English translation #314692 by CK

m.t: Parecía estar contenta con su nuevo trabajo.
m.e: She looked pleased with her new job.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #3209142 by Shishir; English translation #315139 by CK

m.t: Ella parecía contenta con su nuevo anillo.
m.e: She looked pleased with her new ring.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #658336 by darinmex; English translation #315144 by CK

m.t: Ella estaba muy contenta.
m.e: She was very pleased.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1690710 by marcelostockle; English translation #1690434 by Spamster

m.t: Solo estoy contenta de tener turno en fin de semana.
m.e: I'm just glad to have a weekend shift.

m.t: Estoy contenta de saber por fin para quién trabajo.
m.e: I'm just glad to finally know who I'm working for.

m.t: Naomi está muy contenta de haber ganado el primer premio.
m.e: Naomi is very glad about having won first prize.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #871522 by Kokoo; English translation #278255 by sundown

m.t: Oh, estoy tan contenta de haber venido.
m.e: Oh, I'm so glad I came.

m.t: Estoy muy contenta de que estés aquí.
m.e: I'm very glad that you're here.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #8889990 by carlosalberto; English translation #6563232 by txw

m.t: Estoy muy contenta de que seamos amigas.
m.e: I'm really glad we're friends.

m.t: No noté lo contenta que estaba ella.
m.e: I did not notice how glad she was.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1324666 by marcelostockle; English translation #308109 by CK

m.t: Pero estoy contenta de estar aquí.
m.e: But I'm glad to be here.

m.t: ¿No estás contenta de ser rica?
m.e: Aren't you glad you're rich?
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #2744085 by marcelostockle; English translation #1886285 by CK

m.t: ¡Estoy contenta de verte!
m.e: I'm glad to see you!
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #12718974 by Adelpa; English translation #517888 by zmoo

m.t: Yo no estoy contenta.
m.e: I'm not satisfied.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #8874791 by mramosch; English translation #261484 by CK

m.t: Me parece que estaría contenta de verme fuera del negocio.
m.e: It seems to me you'd be content to see me out of business.

m.t: Estoy contenta con lo que tengo.
m.e: I'm happy with what I have.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #2924537 by alexmarcelo; English translation #2915241 by Hybrid

m.t: Una mente contenta es la bendición más grande que un hombre puede disfrutar en este mundo.
m.e: A contented mind is the greatest blessing a man can enjoy in this world.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #6370477 by Adelpa; English translation #6370447 by Adelpa

m.t: Estamos muy contentos de haber aceptado nuestra invitación.
m.e: We're so happy you accepted our invitation.

m.t: Nosotros vamos a estar bien y contentos, y felices y juntos y unidos.
m.e: We'll be fine, and content, and happy, and together and united.

m.t: Como si fuera una competencia pero los dos lados acaban contentos.
m.e: Like, it's a competition, but both sides end up happy.

m.t: Los niños están tan contentos que dan ganas de dejarlos aquí.
m.e: The kids are so happy that I almost want to leave them here.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1100644 by Shishir; English translation #10465348 by DJ_Saidez

m.t: Si quieres que tus empleados estén contentos tienes que pagarles un sueldo aceptable.
m.e: If you want your workers to be happy, you need to pay them a decent wage.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1147884 by Shishir; English translation #1144626 by CK

m.t: Estamos muy contentos con nuestra nueva casa.
m.e: We're very happy with our new house.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #10793531 by megamanenm; English translation #10793527 by megamanenm

m.t: Los padres de Tomás no estaban contentos.
m.e: Tom's parents weren't happy.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #5130191 by don_ramon; English translation #5130146 by CK

m.t: Todos estamos contentos de vernos, ¿verdad?
m.e: We're all happy to see each other, right?

m.t: Bien, estamos contentos de tenerla aquí.
m.e: Well, we're happy to have you here.

m.t: Ellos están contentos con el resultado.
m.e: They are happy with the result.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1726710 by marcelostockle; English translation #1726024 by belgavox

m.t: No es posible que estuvieran contentos.
m.e: They couldn't have been happy.

m.t: Los hombres no están contentos.
m.e: The men aren't happy.

m.t: Se les ve contentos hoy.
m.e: They look happy today.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #2062137 by lazarus1907; English translation #306573 by CK

m.t: Los trabajadores contentos son mejores trabajadores.
m.e: Happy workers are better workers.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #6569784 by arh; English translation #6569192 by CK

m.t: Estamos contentos de que Tom se haya unido a nuestro equipo.
m.e: We're happy that Tom joined our team.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #10180283 by saverius; English translation #10157092 by CK

m.t: Vosotros dos debéis estar contentos.
m.e: You two must be happy.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #2878303 by teskmon; English translation #2646130 by CK

m.t: Siempre tienes que mantenerlos contentos.
m.e: You always have to keep them happy.

m.t: Los pasajeros están contentos.
m.e: The passengers are happy.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1458046 by marcelostockle; English translation #10016485 by espamatics

m.t: - Sí, estamos muy contentos.
m.e: - Yes, we are very happy.

m.t: Ellos estarán contentos, creo.
m.e: They'll be pleased, I think.

m.t: ¿Me puedes decir por qué están tan contentos?
m.e: Can you tell me why they are so glad?
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1068053 by alexmarcelo; English translation #1365696 by \N

m.t: Y estamos muy contentos de que estén aquí.
m.e: And we're really glad you're here.

m.t: Y estamos contentos de que estés en casa.
m.e: And we are glad you're home.

m.t: Estamos... tan contentos de tenerte a bordo.
m.e: We are so glad to have you on board.

m.t: Mis papás están contentos de que vaya.
m.e: My parents are glad I'm gone.

m.t: Estamos realmente contentos de tenerte.
m.e: We're really glad to have you.

m.t: Estamos contentos de que vengas.
m.e: We are glad you are coming.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1999963 by marcelostockle; English translation #71625 by CK

m.t: Estamos contentos de estar aquí.
m.e: We're glad to be here.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #7454447 by Ricardo14; English translation #5011410 by CK

m.t: Y no están contentos de verlo.
m.e: And they don't look so happy to see it.

m.t: Esa mujer no es gorda, va a tener un bebé.
m.e: That woman isn't fat, she is going to have a baby.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1218851 by marcelostockle; English translation #1218133 by \N

m.t: ¿Mi madre acaba de decirle gorda a mi hermana?
m.e: Did my mother just call my sister fat?

m.t: Creo que estoy gorda porque como mucho azúcar y helado.
m.e: I think I am fat because I eat a lot of sugar and ice cream.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #10781631 by carlosalberto; English translation #10781602 by carlosalberto

m.t: Te damos de comer poco porque no te queremos gorda.
m.e: We don't feed you a lot because we don't want you to get fat.

m.t: Entre nos, la bruja gorda y fea está a dieta.
m.e: Between ourselves, the fat ugly witch is on a diet.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1286462 by marcelostockle; English translation #62014 by \N

m.t: La ópera no termina hasta que cante la señora gorda.
m.e: The opera ain't over till the fat lady sings.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1387008 by marcelostockle; English translation #327811 by \N

m.t: ¿Una buena noche para hacer que gente blanca y rica sea menos gorda?
m.e: Good night of making rich white people less fat?

m.t: Tu mamá es tan gorda que rompería el Puente de Londres.
m.e: Your mamma's so fat, she'd break London Bridge.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1208140 by cueyayotl; English translation #1203979 by cntrational

m.t: Esa chica de allí está muy gorda.
m.e: That girl over there is very fat.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #620219 by Shishir; English translation #620062 by ulyssemc1

m.t: Mi tío está delgado, pero mi tía está gorda.
m.e: My uncle is slim, but my aunt is fat.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1018651 by Shishir; English translation #1327474 by CK

m.t: Yo era gorda cuando era más joven.
m.e: I was fat when I was younger.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #2314643 by marcelostockle; English translation #2293567 by CK

m.t: La vaca gorda tiene buena leche.
m.e: The fat cow has good milk.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #11664616 by carlosalberto; English translation #11664608 by carlosalberto

m.t: ¿Me hace este vestido parecer gorda?
m.e: Does this outfit make me look fat?
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #6067531 by albrusgher; English translation #2727366 by Hybrid

m.t: Ella está vieja, fea y gorda.
m.e: She's old, ugly and fat.

m.t: Entonces, ¿cómo están involucrados los militares?
m.e: So then how's the military involved?

m.t: Es un club de militares.
m.e: It's a military club.

m.t: ¿Por qué crees que ese tipo se acercó y le disparó a cinco militares en Chattanooga?
m.e: Why do you think that guy went up and shot five servicemen in Chattanooga?
